title: the stop, six hits out of the break
story: At 123 bpm the full band deals one tile per beat on a havana-tobacco palette: the colour sways on every beat, the tile grid flips every two beats, and the cha-cha pushes land on the three strongest pre-roll peaks. At 9507 the band drops to a stop-time break (rms -2.2 sd, centroid 0.31 to 0.21): the deals slow to one per bar, the colour sways per bar in a dimmed room, and the bar-start onsets get a zoom push. Six strong hits (9796, 9850 strongest, 9919, 9942, 10042, 10065) each open the separacion, push the zoom, flash the colour and flip the verticales and roundness; 9850 alone adds the posterize stab and a 6-fold kaleido. Every stroke above the span's p75 onset strength carries its class on its own float.
